=== ANTHROPIC === (4 findings — biggest single-vendor block in weeks)
news Oct list: 10-07 Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5; 10-06 Expanding the Cyber Verification
  Program; 10-02 $100M engineer training; 10-01 Barclays.
release-notes/api literal Oct list: 10-08 Compliance API + unified Claude experience chats;
  10-07 (SEVEN entries) Sonnet 5.5 cache-read price cut, Haiku 5.5 launch, Haiku 4.5->5.5
  migration breakage, browser/computer use SDK toolsets, Max/Team API credits, limited
  networking allowed_hosts now gates web_search/web_fetch, 400 on allowed_domains outside
  allowed_hosts, web_fetch URL-provenance restriction; 10-06 capabilities.server_tools;
  10-05 capabilities.thinking.types.disabled; 10-01 line field + Dreams model support.
REPORTED:
  * MANAGED AGENTS CLOUD ENVIRONMENTS = uninventoried RESOURCE TYPE. POST /v1/environments,
    list/retrieve/ARCHIVE/delete. Referenced by ID at session create. packages block
    (apt,cargo,gem,go,npm,pip). NETWORKING OMITTED ON API CREATE => "unrestricted".
    Console form defaults opposite (Limited, nothing allowed). SAME provisioning-by-omission
    pattern as AgentCore harness memory. ENVIRONMENTS ARE NOT VERSIONED — no record of which
    config a session used; Anthropic tells operators to keep their own record.
    allow_package_managers=true opens ~40 hosts incl github.com, ghcr.io, registry-1.docker.io.
    "Network access is granted per host, not per operation" — allowed host accepts git push
    and package publishing. Archive != delete; archived env still serves existing sessions.
  * web_fetch URL PROVENANCE (10-07). Only URLs ALREADY IN SESSION: user message text,
    web_search result, or an earlier web_fetch page. NOT qualifying: Claude's own output,
    system prompt, attached document, bash/read/MCP TOOL OUTPUT. Error result to agent =
    `url_not_in_prior_context`. Anthropic states purpose = reduce exfiltration.
    LAUNDERING PATH: get the URL into the text of a user.message event.
    Also 10-07: under `limited`, allowed_hosts now gates SERVER-SIDE web_search/web_fetch;
    empty allowed_hosts => neither tool returns anything; 400 when a tool's allowed_domains
    entry is not within allowed_hosts; host match exact unless entry starts with `*.`.
  * BROWSER-USE + COMPUTER-USE SDK TOOLSETS (10-07, beta, Python+TS). Subclass a class,
    one method per member tool (navigate, left_click) against YOUR OWN browser/desktop
    automation. SDK runs the loop, the policies you pass, the approval callback, builds
    tool_result. SDK ships NO browser, NO desktop, NO driver, NO URL POLICY. Reference CDP
    impl is in claude-quickstarts, labelled not production code. => enforcement point is
    customer-written code on a local host; unreadable from the Anthropic API.
  * COMPLIANCE API now returns UNIFIED CLAUDE EXPERIENCE chats (10-08). Beta, Enterprise
    orgs, EXISTING Compliance Access Key, no new credential. Same pattern as the 09-26
    office_agents local-sessions expansion. Each expansion redraws the blind-spot map.
NOT REPORTED (held below bar): Claude Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5, 1M ctx, 128k out, adaptive
  thinking, on Bedrock+Vertex+Foundry — MODEL-INVENTORY WATCHLIST ITEM); Sonnet 5.5 cache-read
  price cut $0.20->$0.10/M; Max/Team monthly API credits; capabilities.server_tools.

=== AWS AGENTCORE === (2 findings — backlog CLOSED)
release-notes: NO new October heading. Still only "Gateway: Private certificate authority
  support for targets" (reported 10-06). September headings unchanged.
data-plane API: not re-fetched; was byte-identical at 68 ops on 10-06.
REPORTED:
  * harness-versioning.html — auto-versioning. V1 at create; EVERY UPDATE = a NEW IMMUTABLE
    version with a COMPLETE SELF-CONTAINED config (model, system prompt, tools, memory,
    limits, environment). ENDPOINTS pin an env to a version. DEFAULT auto-advances;
    NAMED ENDPOINTS DO NOT and must be updated explicitly. AWS's own table shows harness at
    V3 while PROD still serves V2 — intended behavior. => GetHarness returns the LATEST
    config, NOT what production executes. A tool/guardrail REMOVED stays live on pinned
    endpoints. 6 new ops: Create/Update/Get/DeleteHarnessEndpoint, ListHarnessVersions,
    ListHarnessEndpoints. Endpoint states: CREATING, CREATE_FAILED, READY, UPDATING,
    UPDATE_FAILED (a stuck UPDATE_FAILED = a remediation believed applied that never took).
  * harness-models.html#harness-model-guardrails — BEDROCK GUARDRAILS ONLY WORK WITH
    apiFormat=converse_stream. Passed as guardrailConfig inside bedrockModelConfig.
    additionalParams. apiFormat=responses|chat_completions route to bedrock-mantle instead
    and the guardrail is INERT. apiFormat IS OVERRIDABLE PER INVOCATION (alongside modelId,
    tools, systemPrompt, maxIterations, maxTokens, timeout, skills, allowedTools, actorId).
    => guardrail enforcement depends on a per-request routing field. stop reason
    `guardrail_intervened` simply never appears. Compounds the UNVALIDATED additionalParams
    passthrough reported 09-24/09-28.
BACKLOG CORRECTION: harness-environment + harness-skills were AUDITED 2026-09-25 (filesystem
  mounts, InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand root shell, four skill source types). The carried backlog
  list was stale. Nothing re-reported from them.
HARNESS BACKLOG: CLOSED. Re-walk the tree periodically for NEWLY ADDED pages.
aws_q_*: not fetched. Dead 18+ scans. RETIREMENT RECOMMENDED.
